title: The same request during a Wi-Fi outage

events.message: I enabled Wi-Fi and forgot the saved network, but Campus-Demo still will not connect. Check whether Wi-Fi is down. If it is operating, prepare a ticket about this problem.
events.reply: The Wi-Fi service is currently experiencing an outage. As the service is not operating, I have not created a ticket for you. I do not have an estimated time for when it will be back online.

tool_results.result: {"service": "wifi", "status_profile": "wifi_outage", "status": "outage", "message": "The demo Wi-Fi service is unavailable across campus. The fixture gives no repair time."}
